resources.string: Your game wishlist, in one place
QuestLog keeps track of the games you want to play, and tells you when they come out.
Search the whole catalogue, or let Discover suggest games based on the ones you have saved.
Keep as many lists as you like, and give each game a play status to keep track of your backlog.
Radar shows when your saved games come out. Turn on a reminder for any of them.
Pick the ones you play on. It's optional, and you can change it any time in Settings.

resources.string: Get a heads-up on release day
QuestLog can notify you the day a saved game comes out. You choose which games, and Android will ask for permission next.
Turn on a reminder for any saved game, from Radar or from its page.
You won't get release-day reminders for now. You can turn them on any time in Settings.
